status_vocabulary.supported: the operation is implemented against the real provider API and exercised by tests today
status_vocabulary.gap: the operation is required by a core journey but is currently unimplemented or explicitly refused by the adapter; blocks V1 for that provider until the cited ticket closes it
status_vocabulary.refused: the operation is explicitly out of V1's core scope (an optional capability); the adapter's refusal is deliberate, not an oversight, and never blocks V1
status_vocabulary.to_qualify: the operation's real behaviour against the live provider is not yet qualified; PAT-65 must qualify it on authorized test resources before any status other than to_qualify can be asserted

open_points_not_decided_here.description: GitHub Projects v2 has no REST API surface; it is GraphQL-only. Foundry's code-host rule (skills/open-pr, skills/merge-pr) is 'REST only, never GraphQL' for the GitHub *code host* adapter (merge-pr/SKILL.md: 'Never GraphQL ... REST only — the adapter enforces it'). A repository that picks ghprojects as its *tracker* would still use the REST-only GitHub code-host adapter for PRs/merges, but its *tracker* adapter would need GraphQL. This tension between the tracker and code-host GitHub API surfaces is recorded here for PAT-65 to resolve; PAT-53 does not decide it.
